Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1.1 includes: GDPval-AA v2, 𝜏³-Banking, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, CritPt, AA-Omniscience, AA-LCR . See Intelligence Index methodology for further details, including a breakdown of each evaluation and how we run them.

Indicates whether the model weights are available. Models are labelled as 'Commercial Use Restricted' if the weights are available but commercial use is limited (typically requires obtaining a paid license).

svg]:rotate-45 text-xs text-left font-normal text-muted-foreground border-b border-neutral-100 py-1.5 mb-2 transition-colors hover:text-foreground hover:no-underline" data-radix-collection-item=""> Cost per Intelligence Index Task

Weighted average cost per Intelligence Index task. Each evaluation’s cost is calculated from input, cache hit, cache write, reasoning, and answer token prices, divided by task count, and weighted by its Intelligence Index weight.

svg]:rotate-45 text-xs text-left font-normal text-muted-foreground border-b border-neutral-100 py-1.5 mb-2 transition-colors hover:text-foreground hover:no-underline" data-radix-collection-item=""> Intelligence Evaluation Relevance

While model intelligence generally translates across use cases, specific evaluations may be more relevant for certain use cases.

AA-Briefcase is a frontier agentic evaluation for long-horizon knowledge work, testing agents on realistic business workflows that require deliverables such as spreadsheets, presentations, and memos

svg]:rotate-45 text-xs text-left font-normal text-muted-foreground border-b border-neutral-100 py-1.5 mb-2 transition-colors hover:text-foreground hover:no-underline" data-radix-collection-item=""> AA-Briefcase Elo

AA-Briefcase Elo is a combined metric that aggregates analytical quality Elo, presentation Elo, and rubric pass rate, with rubric performance converted into Elo via synthetic head-to-head matches. Elo and 95% confidence interval bounds are clamped at 0.

AA-Omniscience is a knowledge and hallucination benchmark that rewards accuracy, punishes bad guesses and provides a comprehensive view of which models produce factually reliable outputs across different domains

svg]:rotate-45 text-xs text-left font-normal text-muted-foreground border-b border-neutral-100 py-1.5 mb-2 transition-colors hover:text-foreground hover:no-underline" data-radix-collection-item=""> AA-Omniscience Index

AA-Omniscience Index (higher is better) measures knowledge reliability and hallucination. It rewards correct answers, penalizes hallucinations, and has no penalty for refusing to answer. Scores range from -100 to 100, where 0 means as many correct as incorrect answers, and negative scores mean more incorrect than correct.

GDPval-AA v2 evaluates AI models on real-world, economically valuable tasks across a wide range of occupations

Artificial Analysis Openness Index assesses how 'open' models are on the basis of their availability and transparency across different components.

The number of tokens required per Intelligence Index task. This is calculated by multiplying the output tokens per eval by the relative weights of each benchmark in the Intelligence Index, then dividing by t

虽然模型智能通常可以跨用例转换，但具体评估可能与某些用例更相关。

AA-Briefcase 是针对长期知识工作的前沿代理评估，在需要电子表格、演示文稿和备忘录等可交付成果的实际业务工作流程上测试代理

svg]：旋转45文本-xs文本左字体正常文本静音前景边框-b边框中性-100 py-1.5 mb-2过渡颜色悬停：文本前景悬停：无下划线“data-radix-collection-item =“”> AA-Briefcase Elo

AA-Briefcase Elo 是一个综合指标，聚合了分析质量 Elo、演示 Elo 和评分标准通过率，并通过综合的头对头比赛将评分标准表现转换为 Elo。 Elo 和 95% 置信区间界限固定为 0。

AA-Omniscience 是一个知识和幻觉基准，奖励准确性，惩罚错误的猜测，并提供哪些模型在不同领域产生事实上可靠的输出的全面视图

svg]：旋转45文本-xs文本左字体正常文本静音前景边框-b边框中性-100 py-1.5 mb-2过渡颜色悬停：文本前景悬停：无下划线“data-radix-collection-item =“”> AA-全知索引

AA-全知指数（越高越好）衡量知识可靠性和幻觉。它奖励正确的答案，惩罚幻觉，并且不会因拒绝回答而受到惩罚。分数范围为 -100 到 100，其中 0 表示正确答案与错误答案一样多，负分数表示错误答案多于正确答案。
